purpose: Deliver source-proven parity CSS through page256-owned Elementor content instead of the globally shared Hello Additional CSS field.
scope_basis: Current user package permits page256 modification only and excludes shared/global resources. See reports/subpages/bio-css-delivery-scope-reconciliation-20260914-v001.json.
required_first_proof: build/bio-page-local-style-carrier-probe-20260914-v001.json must PASS in a future usable page256 WPVibe window. A failed/stripped style probe cancels this delivery path.

physical_owner_after_probe.reason: single page-local style owner makes subsequent block insertion/removal surgical while all existing page content remains editable and visible

owner_creation_strategy: After the probe passes and is rolled back/cleaned, fresh-search af260016 again; do not transform the probe into the final owner from stale bytes.
Prepend one final style element containing start/end markers and only the first approved dependency-safe CSS phase.
Keep the original af260016 hero-contact/CTA/fact markup byte-for-byte after the style element.
Immediately read page JSON/hash and rendered page HTML; require style#af-page256-parity exactly once and all original hero-extra content intact.

first_local_visual_payload.delivery_change: Do NOT write Hello Additional CSS. Concatenate only the v007 CSS blocks as text inside style#af-page256-parity.
first_local_visual_payload.note: The fourth FAQ wave remains excluded until the FAQ paper conversion phase.

later_block_append_model.method: Fresh-search the exact internal end marker in af260016 and insert one complete marked CSS block immediately before it with match-once content/edit.
later_block_append_model.precondition_per_block: The corresponding structure/dependency/pseudo-owner/responsive gates must already pass; the existence of the local style owner does not bypass them.
later_block_append_model.marker_rule: Every CSS component keeps its own unique internal /* af-...:start/end */ marker. A marker count of 1 means live; 0 means absent; >1 is stop/reconcile.
later_block_append_model.rollback: Fresh-search the exact component start/end marker range in the page-local style owner and remove only that block. Never rewrite the full page or restore an old full _elementor_data blob.

read_only_global_cascade_checks_still_al: Existing shared/global Additional CSS may be read to identify competing pseudo/cascade owners before page-local overrides.
Read-only inspection of shared resources does not authorize mutating them.
If an essential existing owner conflicts, redesign the page-local block or stop; do not overwrite the global owner.
sanitization_and_editor_safety: A successful inert probe is mandatory because style tags inside text-editor content may be sanitized depending WordPress/Elementor context.
After final owner creation, reopen/read rendered markup and page JSON; do not rely only on database bytes.
If Elementor later strips/moves the style owner or the editor cannot round-trip the widget safely, remove the page-local style element and mark this delivery path unsupported.
